compiled.beat: Everyone present carries the faint, unplaceable sense of having stood here before. Seren looks at her own hands as if checking them. The Dohkar loses his place in a rite he has performed a hundred times. Julian's gaze finds Lirael a moment before there is any reason for it, and neither of them can say why.
